description: The iron and steel tables of Annexes I and II are rendered in the source file with duplicated and merged cell content (the same CN list reappears inside the table), so the table geometry is not faithfully represented as text.
treatment: The unit text is kept exactly as parsed from the frozen file; no statement relies on the geometry; the scope statement is coded at the level of the goods category.
effect_on_claims: Scope claims about individual CN codes in these two tables are limited to the parsed text.

description: The temporal reference (2026-01-01) was selected by the executor from the application dates of Article 36(2); the neutral metadata state no repeal-related information. All legal statuses are recorded for that reference only.
treatment: All norms recorded in_force at 2026-01-01 with a validity note stating the application group; Articles 32-35 recorded in_force with a note on their bounded scope.
effect_on_claims: Legal-status profile is reference-dependent; no status is asserted for other dates.

description: Articles 32-35 apply to the transitional period 1 October 2023 to 31 December 2025; at the 2026-01-01 reference only the last quarterly report (Q4 2025, due one month after the quarter end under A35(1)) remains due, by arithmetic on dates stated in W.
treatment: Recorded in_force with a validity note; epistemic status follows the general rule; no status asserted for later dates.

description: Point 2 of Annex III contains only a bracketed placeholder; no third country or territory is listed for the electricity exemption, so the reporting and assessment relations of A2(8) are constituted as norms with no evidenced instance.
treatment: Relations recorded with a support-gap report; dependencies are expectations, never gates.
effect_on_claims: SC-09 and ARCH-05 hold as norm-level arrangements only.

description: The 'Union market coupling' from which the Commission may exclude third countries is defined by external Regulation (EU) 2015/1222.
treatment: Relation recorded as stated; epistemic status down-coded to documented; left out of the I2 set of ARCH-05.

description: A4 is worded positively ('only by an authorised CBAM declarant'); it is recorded as a prohibition on persons other than authorised declarants, as the restrictive effect of the exclusivity wording.
treatment: Recorded as NA with modality prohibition and constraint_only Y; the reading is stated, not inferred beyond the wording.
effect_on_claims: NA-0002; HQ not required (A25(1) states the prohibition for customs authorities in terms).

description: A6(1), the special reporting rules of A6(3)-(5) and the claim of A9(1) state the declarant's acts without naming the recipient of the CBAM declaration; later provisions attribute review of declarations (A19) but do not say to whom the declaration is addressed.
treatment: Recorded as NAs without a counterparty; no counterparty is invented; the review relations of A19 are coded separately.
effect_on_claims: The declaration is not coded as a relation to any authority.

description: A22(1) states that the declarant shall 'surrender via the CBAM registry' but does not name the recipient of the surrender; the Commission removes surrendered certificates as a registry operation.
treatment: Recorded as two NAs (surrender; removal) with no counterparty created.

description: Record-keeping duties name the verifiers, the Commission and the competent authority as those whom the records are to enable to verify or review (purposive clauses), without stating a communication to them.
treatment: Recorded as NAs; the purposive clause is kept in the conditions field; no QR is created from it.
effect_on_claims: Relations between record-keepers and reviewers are carried by A8, A19 and A10 instead.

description: Textual direction follows the obligor (the declarant ensures verification) while the governance work flows from the verifier to the declarant's declaration; Annex VI states the verifier's duties without naming the verified party (taken by cross-reference to A8(1) and A10(5)(b)).
treatment: Both directions recorded (textual and governance); Annex VI relations marked derived with the rule stated.

description: Passive certification sentences do not state who must obtain the certification or supply the interim reports.
treatment: Origin assigned to the declarant; governance direction recorded; queued.

description: The Commission's duty to adopt an implementing act by 30 June 2025 falls before the 2026-01-01 reference date; whether the act was adopted is a layer-X fact that is not collected.
treatment: Norm recorded in_force with epistemic status documented; fulfilment not assessed.

description: Annex IV points 5-7 let declarants apply actual emissions or region-specific values on demonstration without naming the addressee of the demonstration; point 7 uses the plural 'declarants' without defining a position other than the authorised CBAM declarant.
treatment: Recorded as permissive NAs of the authorised CBAM declarant; no counterparty created.

description: The establishment of the alternative default value is stated passively ('shall be established'); the Commission is the recipient of the demonstration and the only default-value setter named in Annex IV.
treatment: Relation recorded from the third country to the Commission; establishment not coded as a separate duty.

description: Reasons and information on a right to appeal are stated without an identified forum, procedure or consequence.
treatment: Classified INFO with sufficiency indeterminate; missing elements recorded.
effect_on_claims: Accountability profile of SC-01, SC-05, SC-07.

description: Consultation provisions do not state the effect of the consultation on the deciding authority or on the Commission.
treatment: Coded as representation_participation relations with the effect unspecified.
effect_on_claims: Coupling strength of the consultation relations is not inferred.

description: The CBAM registry meets identity and operator/governing-rule/bounded-function criteria (device) but is created by an N2 duty of the Commission; its establishment is not evidenced.
treatment: Coded DEV, not constituted_by_N1; relations using it carry a support-gap report.
effect_on_claims: All relations whose instrument is the registry.

description: The common central platform meets the device criteria but is created by an N2 duty of the Commission; its establishment is not evidenced.
treatment: Coded DEV, not constituted_by_N1; relations using it carry a support-gap report.
effect_on_claims: Relations whose instrument is the platform.

description: Positions named by W but constituted or defined externally: customs authorities, indirect customs representative, national accreditation body.
treatment: Coded as type-level positions with external dependency recorded; epistemic status documented.
effect_on_claims: PD-009, PD-011, PD-017 and relations using them.

description: The competent authority is designated by each Member State under an N2 obligation; no designation is evidenced and the counterpart of the designation relation is a type-level position.
treatment: Relation coded with epistemic status documented; the support gap is stated.
effect_on_claims: QR-0024 and all relations whose party is the competent authority.

description: Recovery of unpaid penalties relies on 'all means available ... under the national law of the Member State concerned'.
treatment: Relation recorded; means undetermined; national law is not part of W.

description: Compound wording: an obligation to grant with conditions.
treatment: Recorded COMPOUND and queued.

description: The CBAM Committee is named and typed ('a committee within the meaning of Regulation (EU) No 182/2011') without an establishing verb; its effect is defined externally.
treatment: Entity not constituted; relation typed at the nearest type.

description: Deeming wording ('shall ... be regarded as an authorised CBAM declarant').
treatment: Recorded AMBIGUOUS and queued.

description: Recognition wording ('shall be an accredited verifier for the purpose of this Regulation').
treatment: Recorded AMBIGUOUS and queued.

description: The indirect customs representative is defined by reference to Article 18 of Regulation (EU) No 952/2013.
treatment: Position coded with external dependency recorded.
effect_on_claims: Relations whose party is the indirect customs representative.

description: A10(8) combines notification, consultation and subsequent information of the competent authorities in three sentences.
treatment: Coded as one relation with the three steps stated.

description: Coordination, assistance and guidelines fit none of the ten relation types exactly.
treatment: Coded authority_control with a type note and a residual function tag; no new type created.

description: A16(2) is passive; the grantor of access is taken to be the Commission through A16(1), A16(3) and A14(1).
treatment: Recorded as derived with the rule stated.

description: A17(4) is passive about who registers the grant decision.
treatment: Taken to be the competent authority; recorded as derived.

description: The platform is the instrument of the sale and not a party; the purchase side (the declarant) is a party and the seller is the Member State.
treatment: Platform recorded as instrument (DEV).

description: The addressee of the repurchase request is not named in A23(1) second subparagraph.
treatment: Taken to be the Member State where the declarant is established, recorded as derived.

description: The 'pending dispute in a Member State' has no identified forum.
treatment: No forum position is created.

description: Penalty amounts rest on Article 16(3)-(4) of Directive 2003/87/EC.
treatment: Assignments recorded at documented; amount undetermined.

description: The investigated conduct belongs to no named position; the investigation relation is recorded towards the notifying parties.
treatment: No party under investigation is created.

description: The conferral clause is passive; the grantors are taken to be the European Parliament and the Council through their opposition and revocation powers.
treatment: Recorded as derived.

description: The Commission assesses Member State administration as part of a report to the legislators; the assessment object (Member States) is not the addressee.
treatment: Recorded as an oversight relation with a type note; no corrective power asserted.

description: 'Relevant stakeholders' is not a defined category.
treatment: No position or counterparty created.

description: The extent of free allocation under Article 10a of Directive 2003/87/EC determines the adjustment.
treatment: Assignment recorded at documented; extent undetermined.

description: The 'CBAM' as the regime established by A1(1) is neither a position nor a device (it has no operator or bounded function of its own); it is not coded as a PD.
treatment: Not coded; the regime is the object of the instrument.

description: Four equations of Annex IV are formula images in the source file and cannot be represented as text; the variables are defined in the adjacent legend tables, which are in W.
treatment: Declared as an exclusion in W_DECLARATION; the legend tables are included in ST-0165.
effect_on_claims: No record depends on the equation content.

description: The data dictionary gives annex point ids but not conventions for goods tables (ANX{n}.TBL{k}), legend tables, unnumbered paragraphs (P{k}) or enumerations without labels (pt-{k}).
treatment: Convention used and logged (GAP-01).
effect_on_claims: Unit ids of annex tables and enumerations.

description: The mapping of the ten architectural dimensions to families F1-F5 is not stated in the allowed sources.
treatment: Provisional assignment by listing order; logged.

description: Three internal cross-references are ambiguous: A2(7)(c) ('points (d) and (e)'), A7(7)(a) ('paragraph 2 ... points 5 and 6 of Annex IV') and A17(8)(b) ('paragraph 2 or 6').
treatment: Resolved within W by the most coherent reading (paragraph 7 points (d)-(e); paragraphs 3 and 4 of Article 7; criteria of paragraph 2 and guarantee condition of paragraph 6) and queued; no record's type, direction or status depends on the choice.
